title: The stone head with a flyer
logline: The face with a crab flyer taped to its brow — the twenty-eighth, a spare — by a hand the page doesn't show, the tape already peeling in the rain. Somebody in town thinks the monument should advertise. The page leaves it and draws the peel.

panels.composition: The carved stone face in rain with a paper crab flyer taped across its brow, the tape peeling at one corner, the shingle wall behind.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a moss-grown carved stone face in rain with a paper crab flyer taped across its brow and the tape peeling at one corner, a shingle wall behind, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
